preclosure_geometry.uncertainty_rule: max(1 mm working floor, two calibrated pixels, three plane RMS); heuristic, not a calibrated confidence bound
preclosure_geometry.scope: Current visible planar top, identified parallel side boundaries and own finger envelope. No hidden clearance claim.
